props.name: items
props.doc: trailing on an item is its current value, shown beside the label.

components.name: ApplicationShell
components.doc: A whole screen: it fills its parent (flex: 1). The top bar and the tab bar stay put; only the page scrolls.

props.name: page
props.doc: The current page id (controlled). Without it the shell keeps its own, starting at defaultPage.

props.name: layout
props.doc: "auto" (default): bottom tabs below 768pt, side rail from there. With more than five pages, or labels too long to fit side by side, the last tab is "More" and opens a sheet with the rest.

props.name: insets
props.doc: The safe-area insets of the app: top pads the top bar below the status bar, bottom pads the tab bar above the home indicator.

props.name: scroll
props.doc: Default true: the page scrolls between the bars. false hands that area to a page that scrolls by itself (a list, a thread).

props.name: actions
props.doc: Replaces the trailing end of the top bar.

props.name: range

props.name: height

props.name: layout

props.name: fill

components.doc: onAction: "open-link" with id = href.

components.name: BottomSheet
components.doc: A sheet that rests at snap points and follows the finger between them on the UI thread. A release keeps its velocity. With scrolling content the list scrolls at the highest point and a pull down from its top moves the sheet.

props.name: keyboardAware
props.doc: Gestures entry only. Default true: while the keyboard is up the content is padded by the part of the sheet the keyboard covers, and the sheet opens to its highest point (reported through onSnapChange) and goes back after.

props.name: animatedHeight
props.doc: Gestures entry only. A shared value (useSharedValue(0)) that receives the visible height of the sheet, in points, on every frame: 0 when closed. Read it in an animated style to move something with the sheet.

props.name: snapPoints
props.doc: Resting heights, as "50%" of the container or points. Default ["50%", "90%"]. Keep the array stable.

props.name: snap
props.doc: Index of the point it rests at (sorted low to high).

props.name: modal
props.doc: Default true: shown in a Modal over the whole screen. false draws it inside its parent.

props.name: backdrop
props.doc: A dimmer behind the sheet that fades with its position; pressing it closes the sheet. Default: same as modal.

props.name: dismissible
props.doc: Pulling below the lowest point, the backdrop and the back button close it. Default true.

props.name: handle
props.doc: Show the drag handle. Default true.

props.name: scroll
props.doc: Default true: the content is a ScrollView that scrolls at the highest point. false renders the children in a plain View.

components.name: Sheet
components.doc: A panel from the bottom edge, as tall as its content. Tap outside, press back or drag it down to close.

props.name: dismissible
props.doc: Gestures entry only. Default true. false: no drag, backdrop or back button closes it, only your own buttons.

props.name: bottomInset
props.doc: Gestures entry only. The home-indicator area to keep clear. Default: a per-device guess.

props.name: testID
props.doc: Gestures entry only.

components.name: Drawer
components.doc: A panel that slides in from an edge and is swiped back the way it came, following the finger. Same props as the core Drawer. Left and right drawers are dragged anywhere; top and bottom ones by their header.

components.name: SwipeRow
components.doc: A list row that follows the finger sideways to reveal actions. A vertical drag is left to the list around it.

props.name: onFullSwipeChange
props.doc: Gestures entry only. Called when the finger crosses the full-swipe point (60% of the row): true going past it, false coming back. Letting go while it is true runs the outer action. A place for haptics.

props.name: leftActions
props.doc: Revealed by swiping right. The first one sits at the outer edge and runs on a full swipe. Keep the arrays stable.

props.name: rightActions
props.doc: Revealed by swiping left.

props.name: actionWidth
props.doc: Width of one action. Default 76.

props.name: fullSwipe
props.doc: A swipe past 60% of the row runs the first action. Default true.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.doc: Read for the whole row; the actions are offered to screen readers as accessibilityActions.

components.name: SwipeGroup
components.doc: Wrap a list in it and at most one SwipeRow stays open.

components.name: Sortable
components.doc: A list reordered by dragging: the row follows the finger and its neighbours slide out of the way on the UI thread. Screen readers get "Move up" and "Move down" on the grip; on the web the grip takes the arrow keys.

props.name: dragOn
props.doc: Gestures entry only. What starts a drag. "both" (default): the grip, or a press and hold anywhere on the row. "handle": the grip only. "longPress": press and hold only (the grip is still shown, for the accessibility actions).

props.name: scrollRef
props.doc: Gestures entry only. The animated ref (useAnimatedRef) of the Animated.ScrollView the list is inside. With it the list scrolls by itself while a row is held near the top or bottom edge of that scroll view.

props.name: onDragStart
props.doc: Gestures entry only. A row was picked up.

props.name: onDragEnd
props.doc: Gestures entry only. A row was put down; from and to are its positions before and after.
props.type: (item: T, move: { from: number; to: number }) => void

props.name: value
props.doc: The items in order.

props.name: renderItem
props.doc: The content of a row. Default: the item's label as text.

props.name: keyExtractor
props.doc: Default: item.id ?? item.value ?? the item itself.

props.name: getLabel
props.doc: The item's name for assistive technology. Default: item.label ?? item.title ?? item.name ?? the item.

props.name: handle
props.doc: Which side the grip is on. Default "end".

props.name: label
props.doc: The accessible name of the list.

components.name: Slider
components.doc: A single or range slider whose thumbs follow the finger on the UI thread. Same props as the core Slider. onChange is called each time the stepped value changes during a drag, onChangeEnd once at the end.

components.name: Carousel
components.doc: A pager whose marker (and parallax) follow the scroll position on the UI thread.

props.name: parallax
props.doc: Gestures entry only. 0 to 1, default 0. The content of each slide moves at this fraction of the page's speed while the pager is dragged, so it seems to sit behind the page. Off under reduced motion.

props.name: testID
props.doc: Gestures entry only.

props.name: children
props.doc: Each child is one slide.

props.name: autoplay
props.doc: Milliseconds between slides; 0 is off. Off under reduced motion.

components.name: AnimatedList
components.doc: A list whose rows fade in, fade out and glide to new places when data changes (Reanimated layout animations). Not virtualized: for tens of rows.

props.name: keyExtractor
props.doc: Must be stable for an item. Default: item.id ?? item.key ?? the item itself.

props.name: entering
props.doc: How a new row arrives. Default FadeIn.duration(220). null: no animation.

props.name: exiting
props.doc: How a removed row leaves. Default FadeOut.duration(160). null: no animation.

props.name: layout
props.doc: How the remaining rows move to their new places. Default LinearTransition.duration(240). null: no animation.

props.name: initial
props.doc: Also animate the rows present on the first render. Default false.

props.name: stagger
props.doc: With initial: each row starts this many milliseconds after the one before it. Default 0.

props.name: horizontal
props.doc: Lay the rows out in a row instead of a column.

props.name: itemStyle
props.doc: Style of the view around each row.

props.name: scale
props.doc: Size while pressed, as a fraction. Default 0.96.

props.name: pressedOpacity
props.doc: Opacity while pressed. Default 1 (no dimming).

props.name: delay
props.doc: Milliseconds before the feedback starts. Default 0; about 80 stops rows flashing when a scroll starts on them.

props.name: style
props.doc: A plain style: not a function of the pressed state.
